001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedElement;
004import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedObject;
005import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedPrimitive;
006import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.processor.ObjectProcessor;
007import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigClosedException;
008import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.UnstructuredFileConfig;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
011import java.nio.file.Path;
012import java.util.Map;
013import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
014
015/**
016 * A Simple Unstructured File Config for storing key/value pairs in a File
017 *
018 * @version 5.1.0
019 * @since 2.0.0
020 */
021public class UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig extends UnstructuredFileConfig {
022    /**
023     * Create a new UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig
024     *
025     * @param file      The file where data is being stored
026     * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
027     *
028     * @since 2.0.0
029     */
030    protected UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig(@NotNull Path file, @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
031        super(file, processor);
032    }
033
034    /**
035     * Create a blank config file
036     *
037     * @return The config bytes
038     *
039     * @throws IOException On create error
040     * @since 1.0.0
041     */
042    @Override
043    protected byte @NotNull [] create() throws IOException {
044        if (this.closed) {
045            throw new ConfigClosedException();
046        }
047
048        return "\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Load the config
053     *
054     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
055     *
056     * @throws IOException On load error
057     * @since 1.3.0
058     */
059    @Override
060    public void load(boolean save) throws IOException {
061        if (this.closed) {
062            throw new ConfigClosedException();
063        }
064
065        synchronized (SAVELOAD_LOCK) {
066            this.config = ParsedObject.create();
067
068            for (String line : new String(this.loadRaw(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).split("\n")) {
069                line = line.trim();
070                if (line.isBlank()) {
071                    continue;
072                }
073
074                String[] splitLine = line.split("=", 3);
075
076                String path = splitLine[0];
077                String type = splitLine[1].toUpperCase();
078                ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType primitiveType = ParsedPrimitive.PrimitiveType.valueOf(type);
079                String value = splitLine[2];
080
081                ParsedPrimitive element = ParsedPrimitive.from(ParsedPrimitive.fromString(value).to(primitiveType));
082
083                this.config.set(path, element);
084            }
085
086            if (save) {
087                this.save();
088            }
089        }
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Save the config to bytes
094     *
095     * @return The config bytes
096     *
097     * @throws IOException On save error
098     * @since 1.0.0
099     */
100    @Override
101    protected byte @NotNull [] saveRaw() throws IOException {
102        if (this.config == null) {
103            return this.create();
104        }
105
106        StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
107
108        for (Map.Entry<String, ParsedElement> entry : this.config.getEntries()) {
109            String key = entry.getKey();
110            ParsedElement element = entry.getValue();
111            if (element.isPrimitive()) {
112                if (key.contains("=")) {
113                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Key cannot contain '='");
114                }
115                data.append(key).append("=").append(element.asPrimitive().getType().name()).append("=").append(!element.asPrimitive().isNull() ? element.asPrimitive().get().toString() : "null").append("\n");
116            }
117        }
118
119        return data.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * A builder class for creating new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig}s
124     *
125     * @version 5.0.0
126     * @since 4.0.0
127     */
128    public static class Builder {
129        /**
130         * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
131         *
132         * @since 4.0.0
133         */
134        protected @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
135
136        /**
137         * The file to use
138         *
139         * @since 4.0.0
140         */
141        protected @NotNull Path file;
142
143        /**
144         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig} builder
145         *
146         * @param file The file to use
147         *
148         * @since 4.0.0
149         */
150        public Builder(@NotNull Path file) {
151            this.processor = new ObjectProcessor.Builder().build();
152
153            this.file = file;
154        }
155
156        /**
157         * Get the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
158         *
159         * @return The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
160         *
161         * @since 4.0.0
162         */
163        public @NotNull ObjectProcessor getProcessor() {
164            return this.processor;
165        }
166
167        /**
168         * Set the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
169         *
170         * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
171         *
172         * @return Self for chaining
173         *
174         * @since 4.0.0
175         */
176        public @NotNull Builder setProcessor(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
177            this.processor = processor;
178            return this;
179        }
180
181        /**
182         * Get the file to use
183         *
184         * @return The file to use
185         *
186         * @since 4.0.0
187         */
188        public @NotNull Path getFile() {
189            return this.file;
190        }
191
192        /**
193         * Set the file to use
194         *
195         * @param file The file to use
196         *
197         * @return Self for chaining
198         *
199         * @since 4.0.0
200         */
201        public @NotNull Builder setFile(@NotNull Path file) {
202            this.file = file;
203            return this;
204        }
205
206
207        /**
208         * Creating a new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig}
209         *
210         * @return A new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.file.simple.UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig}
211         *
212         * @since 4.0.0
213         */
214        public @NotNull UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig build() {
215            return new UnstructuredSimpleFileConfig(this.file, this.processor);
216        }
217    }
218}
